objectives.en: Read a Roman numeral from I to C and say the number it means.
objectives.yo: Ka Roman numeral láti I dé C, kí o sì sọ nọ́ńbà tí ó túmọ̀ sí.
objectives.pcm: Read any Roman numeral from I reach C and talk the number wey e mean.

objectives.en: Write a number up to one hundred as a Roman numeral.
objectives.yo: Kọ nọ́ńbà tí kò ju one hundred lọ ní Roman numeral.
objectives.pcm: Write any number wey no pass one hundred as Roman numeral.

curriculum.objective: Read and write Roman numerals I to C (1 to 100)
curriculum.note: Three scheme families give three different weeks; the topic sits in first term, weeks 3 to 5.

say.en: The big clock at home shows I, II, III. Those letters are Roman numerals.
say.yo: Aago ńlá nílé fi I, II, III hàn. Àwọn lẹ́tà yẹn ni Roman numerals.
say.pcm: The big clock for house dey show I, II, III. Those letters na Roman numerals.

say.en: Today you will read Roman numerals and write numbers in them by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí, ìwọ fúnra rẹ yóò ka Roman numerals, ìwọ yóò sì kọ nọ́ńbà nínú wọn.
say.pcm: Today you go fit read Roman numerals and write numbers with dem by yourself.

say.en: First, counting in tens. Count in tens from ten to fifty.
say.yo: Ní àkọ́kọ́, kíkà ní ten ten. Kà ní ten ten láti ten dé fifty.
say.pcm: First, counting for ten ten. Count for ten ten from ten reach fifty.

say.en: I is one, V is five, X is ten. A letter after a bigger one adds: X I is eleven.
say.yo: I jẹ́ one, V jẹ́ five, X jẹ́ ten. Lẹ́tà tó tẹ̀lé èyí tó tóbi jù ń fi kún un: X I jẹ́ eleven.
say.pcm: I na one, V na five, X na ten. Letter wey dey after bigger one dey add: X I na eleven.

say.en: A small letter before a big one takes away: I X is nine. Your turn: what is four, letter by letter?
say.yo: Lẹ́tà kékeré ṣáájú èyí tóbi ń yọ kúrò: I X jẹ́ nine. Ìwọ ná: sọ four, lẹ́tà lẹ́tà.
say.pcm: Now make we do am the other way, letters from number. Ten na X. Thirty na X X X. Your turn: talk the Roman numeral for four, letter by letter.

say.en: Your turn alone. What number is the Roman numeral X I I?
say.yo: Ìwọ nìkan báyìí. Nọ́ńbà wo ni Roman numeral X I I?
say.pcm: Na your turn alone. Which number be the Roman numeral X I I?

say.en: Take the letters one at a time. X is ten, I is one, the next I is one more. Add them.
say.yo: Tí o bá ṣì í, mú àwọn lẹ́tà náà lọ́kọ̀ọ̀kan. X jẹ́ ten, I jẹ́ one, I kejì sì jẹ́ one mìíràn. Fi wọ́n kún ara wọn.
say.pcm: If you miss am, take the letters one by one. X na ten, I na one, and the second I na one more. Add dem together.

say.en: Let us see what you remember, no help. What number is the Roman numeral L X?
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká wo ohun tí o rántí, láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́. Nọ́ńbà wo ni Roman numeral L X?
say.pcm: Make we see wetin you remember, no help. Which number be the Roman numeral L X?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we read Roman numerals again. Soon we put numbers in order.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ka Roman numerals. Láìpẹ́ a ó to àwọn nọ́ńbà ní ètò.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go read Roman numerals again. Soon we go arrange whole numbers with less than and greater than.
